summary: Verified UI migration of Stock Value report from Orders → Dashboard 'Stock Value' KPI drill-down, plus sign-out redirect. All 6 acceptance criteria pass on web preview at mobile viewport (390x844). Login (warehouse@test.com/test123) succeeded; tapping stat-cash-multiple on Dashboard navigates to /warehouse-overview?mode=value where the 15-month stock-value line chart, wo-date-input (YYYY-MM-DD), wo-today, wo-export-pdf and wo-export-csv are all rendered. Entering 2025-06-01 in wo-date-input did not crash and triggered a /reports/stock-history refetch; tapping wo-today cleared the value (DOM value = '', placeholder restored as confirmed by screenshot). wo-export-csv triggered a CSV download (INVENTMENT_stock_2026-06-28.csv). Orders tab (Purchase Orders) NO LONGER contains any wo-date-input / wo-export-csv / wo-export-pdf / stock-value graph — only ai-insight-btn, suggestions, auto-po-btn and order history remain. Sign-out from Settings (logout-btn) redirects to /login and shows the email/password form. No deprecated expo packages detected.
critical_code_review_comments: warehouse-overview.tsx is ~380 lines and is starting to accumulate multiple concerns (warehouse overview + value/units/products/low modes + export filters + PDF/CSV generation). Consider extracting exportPdf/exportCsv/buildRows into a hook (e.g. useStockExports) for maintainability if the file keeps growing.
exportPdf/exportCsv/load all swallow errors via empty catch blocks ('} catch {}'). User gets no feedback if /reports/stock-at-date or printing fails; consider surfacing a toast/Alert.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stock Value report UI (chart + date filter + PDF/CSV export) now lives only under /warehouse-overview?mode=value, reached by tapping the Dashboard 'Stock Value' KPI (testID stat-cash-multiple). Orders tab is purely PO-focused. Sign-out (testID logout-btn in Settings) navigates to /login via router.replace.
rca_of_issue: Initial test reported wo-today not clearing the date (Playwright ElementHandle.input_value() returned stale value '2025-06-01'). Re-checked via page.evaluate(...).value which returned '' and screenshot confirmed placeholder restored — so the bug was in the test, not the app. Today button works correctly.
